questions.text: A resistor's colour bands read brown, black, red. What is its resistance, in ohms?
questions.textZh: 色环电阻的色环依次是棕、黑、红，它的阻值是多少欧姆？

image.alt: A precision resistor with colour bands

questions.text: A resistor's colour bands read yellow, violet, orange. What is its resistance, in ohms?
questions.textZh: 色环电阻的色环依次是黄、紫、橙，它的阻值是多少欧姆？

questions.text: A gold fourth band on a resistor means a tolerance of ± how many percent?
questions.textZh: 电阻的第四道金色色环表示误差为正负百分之几？

questions.text: 12 V is applied across a 4 Ω resistor. How many amperes flow?
questions.textZh: 在 4 Ω 的电阻两端加 12 V 电压，电流是多少安培？

questions.text: A device draws 2 A from a 5 V supply. How many watts does it use?
questions.textZh: 一个设备从 5 V 电源取 2 A 电流，功率是多少瓦？

questions.text: Two 100 Ω resistors are connected in parallel. What is the total resistance, in ohms?
questions.textZh: 两个 100 Ω 的电阻并联，总电阻是多少欧姆？

questions.text: Two 10 µF capacitors are connected in series. What is the total capacitance, in µF?
questions.textZh: 两个 10 µF 的电容串联，总电容是多少微法？

questions.text: A ceramic capacitor is marked 104. What is its capacitance, in nanofarads?
questions.textZh: 陶瓷电容上标着 104，它的电容是多少纳法？

questions.text: Copper's resistance rises by a temperature coefficient of 0.00393 per °C at 20 °C. How many parts per million (ppm) per °C is that?
questions.textZh: 铜在 20 °C 时电阻的温度系数为每摄氏度 0.00393，换算成每摄氏度多少 ppm（百万分之一）？

image.alt: An NTC thermistor, a resistor made to change with temperature
image.altZh: NTC 热敏电阻——阻值随温度变化的电阻

questions.text: Copper's resistivity is about how many × 10⁻⁸ Ω·m (two decimal places)?
questions.textZh: 铜的电阻率约为多少 × 10⁻⁸ Ω·m（保留两位小数）？

questions.text: About how many volts does a silicon diode drop when it conducts?
questions.textZh: 硅二极管导通时的正向压降约为多少伏？

questions.text: About how many volts does a germanium diode drop when it conducts?
questions.textZh: 锗二极管导通时的正向压降约为多少伏？

questions.text: A 10 kΩ resistor charges a 100 µF capacitor. What is the time constant RC, in seconds?
questions.textZh: 10 kΩ 的电阻给 100 µF 的电容充电，时间常数 RC 是多少秒？

questions.text: After one time constant, a charging capacitor reaches what percent of the supply voltage (one decimal place)?
questions.textZh: 经过一个时间常数后，充电的电容达到电源电压的百分之几（保留一位小数）？

image.altZh: 电容充电时的电压曲线

questions.text: A red LED (2 V drop) runs at 20 mA from a 9 V battery. What series resistor is needed, in ohms?
questions.textZh: 红色 LED（压降 2 V）用 9 V 电池供电、电流 20 mA，需要串联多少欧姆的电阻？

questions.text: A transistor has a current gain β of 100 and a base current of 20 µA. What is the collector current, in mA?
questions.textZh: 晶体管的电流放大倍数 β 为 100，基极电流为 20 µA，集电极电流是多少毫安？

questions.text: How many different values can a 10-bit analog-to-digital converter output?
questions.textZh: 一个 10 位的模数转换器（ADC）可以输出多少个不同的数值？

questions.text: An LC circuit has L = 1 mH and C = 1 µF. What is its resonant frequency, in hertz (nearest whole number)?
questions.textZh: LC 电路中 L = 1 mH、C = 1 µF，谐振频率是多少赫兹（取整数）？

questions.text: A 555 timer runs astable with R1 = R2 = 10 kΩ and C = 10 µF. What is its frequency, in hertz (f = 1.44 / ((R1 + 2R2)C))?
questions.textZh: 555 定时器无稳态工作，R1 = R2 = 10 kΩ，C = 10 µF，频率是多少赫兹（f = 1.44 / ((R1 + 2R2)C)）？

questions.text: Doubling the power is an increase of how many decibels (two decimal places)?
questions.textZh: 功率加倍相当于增加多少分贝（保留两位小数）？
